subject: negative values for z_i and p_ij?

messages.author: d801fdf2fefdd38e
messages.subject: negative values for z_i and p_ij?
parts:
Hi,
I'm new to this package and not understanding how I can get negative values (and those >1) for the state variable and the detection variable. It seems to me these should be bounded between 0 and 1, but when I run the code below (for example), I see that the confidence intervals for these variables include values that are both negative and greater than 1. Am I misinterpreting these variables? Do I need to transform them?
Thank you,
Mikey

# example code
library(unmarked)
y <- structure(list(E01 = c(0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L), E02 = c(0L, 1L, 0L, 0L, 1L, 1L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L), E03 = c(1L,1L, 0L, 0L, 1L, 1L, 0L, 0L, 1L, 0L), E04 = c(0L, 1L, 0L, 0L,1L, 1L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L), E05 = c(1L, 1L, 0L, 0L, 1L, 1L, 0L,0L, 0L, 0L), E06 = c(1L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 1L, 1L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L),E07 = c(1L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 0L, 0L, 0L), E08 = c(1L,0L, 0L, 0L, 1L, 1L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L), E09 = c(1L, 1L, 0L,0L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 0L, 0L, 0L), E10 = c(1L, 1L, 0L, 0L, 1L,0L, 1L, 0L, 0L, 0L), E11 = c(1L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L,0L, 0L, 0L), E12 = c(1L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L,0L)), row.names = c(NA, 10L), class = "data.frame") 
umf <- unmarkedFrameOccu(y = y)
m1 <- occu(~1 ~1, data = umf)
confint(m1, type="state")
confint(m1, type="det")

messages.author: 4f80e1927b0757cb
messages.subject: Re: negative values for z_i and p_ij?
parts:
Hi Mikey,

Those values are on the logit scale. You need to transform them to get the probability values you expect. You can do this in unmarked with the backTransform function:

confint(backTransform(m1, type="state"))
confint(backTransform(m1, type="det"))

Ken
